reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin marketplace for discovering, installing, updating, configuring, diagnosing, and removing community plugins and themes, with optional backup synchronization and local host restart controls.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览搜索社区插件与主题，并执行安装、更新、启用、禁用、备份恢复和诊断管理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin marketplace for browsing and searching community plugins and themes and managing their installation, updates, configuration, backups, and diagnostics.

capabilities: Browses and searches a live community plugin catalog
Installs, updates, disables, enables, and uninstalls plugins
Installs and switches community themes
Reads and writes plugin profiles and configuration files
Exports and restores plugin configuration backups
Optionally syncs backups through WebDAV or GitHub Gist
Runs diagnostics and modifies plugin load order
Can request a local host restart when needed
Fetches plugin metadata and images from external hosts
